results.title: Empire Waist
results.overview: Lenore Miller’s size has always earned her teases and jeers in her school’s hallways, but this clothes-loving teenager is about to set the world on fire with her own line of inclusive fashion designs.

results.title: Largo Winch: The Price of Money
results.original_title: Largo Winch : Le Prix de l'argent
results.overview: Largo Winch, devastated by the kidnapping of his son, realizes that if he finds those responsible for his bankruptcy, maybe he'll see his son again.

results.title: The Book of Clarence
results.overview: Streetwise but down-on-his-luck, Clarence is struggling to find a better life for his family, while fighting to free himself of debt. Captivated by the power and glory of the rising Messiah and His apostles, he risks everything to carve his own path to a divine life, and ultimately discovers that the redemptive power of belief may be his only way out.

results.title: Meet Me Next Christmas
results.overview: On a quest to reconnect with the man of her dreams, Layla races across New York City to find a ticket to a sold-out Pentatonix Christmas Eve concert.

results.title: Halfway There
results.overview: The story of two best friends Lisa and Chris, who are in love but for fear of getting lost decide not to risk each other and ruin everything, years later they meet again reliving old memories

results.title: Junebug
results.overview: When an eight-year-old version of herself starts appearing to her, Juniper begins to realize that her life is not what she had hoped it would be as a child. Young Junebug pushes Juniper to achieve her dreams, to start writing again, and to collaborate with the cute artist Alex to get her life back on track.

results.title: Aftermath
results.overview: A returning war veteran, stricken with PTSD, gets trapped with his teenage sister on Boston's Tobin Memorial Bridge when a heavily armed group of ex-military revolutionaries take everyone hostage.

results.title: The Hikers
results.overview: Three friends decide to go on a sporting vacation in the forest, excited by the idea of discovering the legendary Lac du Fallu. With their backpacks and a tent, they venture out onto the wilderness trails. The Hikers expedition takes an unexpected and naughty turn when they come across two attractive men, also on their way to the mysterious lake. The attraction is immediate, and what was meant to be a simple hike turns into a sensual adventure, where the surrounding nature serves as the backdrop for intimate, passionate moments. The laughter and fun shared by the lake become the highlight of an unforgettable vacation.

results.title: Santosh
results.overview: A government scheme sees newly widowed Santosh inherit her husband’s job as a police constable in the rural badlands of Northern India. When a low-caste girl is found raped and murdered, she is pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma.

results.title: Apartment 7A
results.overview: A struggling young dancer finds herself drawn in by dark forces when a peculiar, well-connected older couple promise her a shot at fame.

results.title: Mischief
results.overview: Sex and rumors abound in this erotic story about high school student Jules, who won’t stop at anything to get back best friend Dahlia from new student Nessa, even if it means making up stories of illicit affairs with teachers.

results.title: Uprising
results.overview: In the Joseon Dynasty, two friends who grew up together — one the master and one the servant — reunite post-war as enemies on opposing sides.

results.title: Âme Cœur
results.overview: "Âme Cœur" tells the story of Shayna, who spends her first four years in an orphanage in South Africa. Later, she is adopted by Veer, a 50-year-old widower of Mauritian origin living in Johannesburg. Shayna, an artist devoted to painting, writing, and social projects, sees her life take a drastic turn when she suffers a stroke after a music and dance performance. Plunged into a coma for several days at the clinic, she is eventually taken off life support following Veer's traumatic decision, with the support of Dr. Jimmie. Veer then fulfills his daughter's last wish: to donate her organs.

results.title: Soledá
results.overview: A young livestock farmer finds herself trapped in a stifling routine of loneliness due to her limited relationship with her father and the lack of people in her village. However, the appearance of a particular friend manages to change her daily life.

results.title: Katas
results.overview: Carmina, who works as a maid in a mansion and soon learns about the dirty secret of their masters, Alex and Grace.

results.title: Sleeping Princess
results.overview: A sheltered teenager discovers she's actually a princess from another country — and she could be in grave danger. Based on Paula Pimenta's novel.

results.title: Crew
results.overview: Three ordinary air hostesses from Mumbai embark on a journey to pursue their dreams but find themselves caught up in unexpected misfortunes.

results.title: Amber Alert
results.overview: A ride-share turns into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse after it follows a car fitting the description of an AMBER Alert.

results.title: Ghost Factory
results.overview: The story of what happens when a small "reality" television show shoots its last episode at the long abandoned Petrie Munitions Factory, and encounters the long dead evil owner Malcom. The show Terror TV is shooting the first show of its second season with the premise that the show places contestants in "haunted" locations and they get paid if they stay and "survive" one night. When the contestants and crew begin to speak of ghostly sightings and visions, mayhem ensures. The cast and crew of the show have their reality challenged by the captured souls of the children who have long suffered under Petrie's spell.

results.title: Time Cut
results.overview: A teen in 2024 accidentally time-travels to 2003, days before a masked killer murders her sister. Can she change the past without destroying the future?
